posts.title: One subtle difference in Surah Al-Isra (Verses 5 & 7) that makes you stop and re-read the whole page… 📖
posts.caption:
One subtle difference in Surah Al-Isra (Verses 5 & 7) that makes you stop and re-read the whole page… 📖

For 1,000+ years, 40 major classical scholars of tafsir assumed both promises had already passed in 597 BC and 70 CE. 

Looking at the world 500 years ago, who could have imagined otherwise?

Yet look at the exact Arabic in Verse 5 vs. Verse 7:
✨ First promise: "Wa kāna wa'dan maf'ūlā" (a promise fulfilled).
✨ Second promise: That phrase never appears.
